harm_levels.l1_desc: Multivitamins, minerals, probiotics — minimal inherent clinical toxicity.
harm_levels.l2_desc: Antacids, H2 blockers, PPIs — monitor for mild GI or drowsiness effects.
harm_levels.l3_desc: NSAIDs, CCBs, antibiotics — routine clinical monitoring advised.
harm_levels.l4_desc: Statins, SSRIs, ACEIs, antidiabetics — high-alert prescription medicine.
harm_levels.l5_desc: Anticoagulants (Warfarin), insulins, anticonvulsants — narrow therapeutic index.

passport.disclaimer: Clinical Safety Notice: This Medication Passport is an informational summary compiled by PolySafe for collaborative clinician-patient communication. It does not replace independent medical judgment, physician prescription orders, or emergency paramedic triage.
passport.cut_fold_instructions: ✂ Cut along dashed perimeter and fold in half to fit standard wallet slot

medication_card.acb_mod: Moderate cognitive risk. Associated with memory impairment. Avoid in 65+ patients if possible.
medication_card.acb_high: High anticholinergic burden. Strongly associated with delirium and falls. Review this regimen.
